_comment: Curated map of HPD marketing agents -> the buildings whose lotteries they actually ran.
Why this is hand-curated and not scraped: NYC publishes no building->agent mapping anywhere.
The two Housing Connect open datasets (nibs-na6y 'Advertised Lotteries by Building' and
vy5i-a666 'by Lottery') carry unit counts, AMI bands and dates but no agent column, and the
Housing Connect SPA's own API has no agent field either. HPD's advertisement PDFs name the
program (LIHTC / 421-a / IH) and a phone number, not the firm. So the only reliable sources
are the agent's own portfolio page, the lottery microsite, or the 'c/o <agent>' line in the
Every entry below cites where the attribution came from. Do not add a building on the
strength of a news article that merely names the developer - developer != marketing agent.
This is a partial map, seeded from the Rose Associates NY portfolio (rosenyc.com/communities).
Units = the income-restricted count in that lottery, not the building's total unit count.
